snippet.title: USURPATIO - playable DEMO is dropping very soon
snippet.description:
Life is no longer born. It is manufactured.
In the near future, humanity no longer waits for the miracle of birth. New governments, corporations and machines take control over the creation of life. What was once the work of nature and the divine spark becomes production.
